strings.zh: 请选择一起料理的朋友。
有无法参加的人员,{SCROLL}请再一次从新开始手续。
strings.en: Someone can’t take part.{SCROLL}Please start again from the beginning.

strings.zh: 那么！{NEWLINE}请从背包里选择{CLEAR}作为料理用的果实！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Now then!{NEWLINE}Please choose a Berry from your Bag to{CLEAR}cook with!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 想混合的果实就一起放进锅里{NEWLINE}旋转混合！{SCROLL}会出现旋转方向指针,{NEWLINE}请照方向旋转！{SCROLL}旋转慢的话就会烧焦！{SCROLL}旋转过快面底就会飞出去要小心{SCROLL}要是做得好,松饼就会很美味！{SCROLL}能参加料理的上限人数是４人。
strings.en: Put the Berries you want to mix into the{NEWLINE}pot and stir them together!{SCROLL}An arrow will show you which way to stir.{NEWLINE}Stir that way!{SCROLL}Stir too slowly, and it’ll burn!{SCROLL}Stir too fast, and the batter will spill{NEWLINE}out, so be careful!{SCROLL}Do it well, and the Poffins will be{NEWLINE}delicious!{SCROLL}Up to four people can cook together.
Come on over if you’d like to cook!
